messages:
Megan (CS): quick heads-up — Orchid Systems (acct_id: ORCH-993) just pinged about invoice 2026-04-01. Sales says they issued a contract credit attached to PO 45678 but customer still shows full charge. Screenshot attached: https://drive.redwood/example-orchid-PO45678.png

Ryan (Sales): i processed a credit memo on Mar 25, memo id SM-2026-102, included PO# in the sales notes. i thought finance would mirror it into the billing ledger automatically — did that not land? @Devon any idea? :eyes:

Devon (Billing): not seeing any ledger credit for SM-2026-102 or PO 45678 for ORCH-993. can you confirm amount? also need the original invoice id (you listed 2026-04-01) and the exact amount to apply.

Megan (CS): amount was $45,000 USD. invoice 2026-04-01, account ORCH-993. customer is escalating — they say payment terms reference the PO and expected the credit to reduce the balance.

Ryan (Sales): confirmed $45,000, PO 45678. i added a PO note in the CRM but maybe the CRM->billing sync didn't map PO fields. i can forward the sales memo PDF if that helps.

Olivia (Engineering): i can check ingestion logs quickly. possible two failure modes: (1) sales webhook didn't POST to billing, (2) our parser failed to extract the PO id and created an orphan memo. quick diagnostic queries i ran: `SELECT id, account_id, reference, status FROM billing_credits WHERE reference LIKE '%SM-2026-102%';` -> zero rows. also `SELECT * FROM promo_notes WHERE po_number='45678';` -> zero rows.

Olivia (Engineering): also ran `kubectl logs -l app=billing -n prod | grep 45678` — nothing. looks like the sales event never reached billing or was dropped.

Devon (Billing): ok. we need to do a manual adjustment so the customer isn't charged. Finance needs to create a credit memo and apply it to invoice 2026-04-01. Tess, can finance create a negative invoice / credit for $45,000 and mark it applied? please include reference=SM-2026-102 and PO=45678.

Tess (Finance): got it. i will create credit note CN-2026-581 and apply to invoice 2026-04-01. ETA 2 hours. will attach the applied credit entry to the ledger and send confirmation email to customer.

Devon (Billing): once Tess creates CN-2026-581, i will run the internal apply step so balance shows correctly in the billing portal. For reproducibility, here's the internal API call i'll use (ops-only):
```
curl -X POST https://internal-billing.redwood/api/v1/credits \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_INTERNAL_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"account_id":"ORCH-993","amount_cents":4500000,"currency":"USD","reference":"SM-2026-102","po_number":"45678","apply_to_invoice_id":"2026-04-01","reason":"Sales-issued contract credit (manual)"}'
```
Devon (Billing): after creating the entry i'll run `SELECT * FROM ledger_entries WHERE reference='SM-2026-102' AND account_id='ORCH-993';` and paste results here for audit.

Ryan (Sales): thanks team. long-term we should avoid manual steps — is there a small change to the CRM->billing sync to reject events missing `po_number` or to alert sales if the webhook 3xx/4xx?

Olivia (Engineering): yep — follow-up ticket proposed: add webhook delivery retries + a push validation that `po_number` is present OR attach a sales_memo_id that maps to billing_credits. i can prototype a hook that returns 409 if required fields missing. i'll open a PR after we stabilize the immediate fix.

Megan (CS): customer message to send after we apply: "We've applied your contract credit CN-2026-581 (PO 45678) to invoice 2026-04-01. Your outstanding balance is now $0. Please see attached credit memo." — i'll send once Tess confirms.

AcctBot: Billing ticket created: BILL-7891 assigned to Devon (Billing).

Devon (Billing): update — i created the ledger entry after Tess confirmed. ledger entry id LE-33412, credit memo CN-2026-581 applied to invoice 2026-04-01. Query output: `LE-33412 | ORCH-993 | -4500000 | USD | SM-2026-102 | PO:45678 | applied_to:2026-04-01`

Tess (Finance): emailed the customer and attached CN-2026-581 PDF. cc'd Ryan.

Megan (CS): customer replied: "thank you — saw the credit, all good." marking resolved on our side. please follow up on the CRM sync change so this doesn't repeat. :tada:

Olivia (Engineering): note for the follow-up ticket: add a one-time backfill script to match sales memos from Mar 1–Mar 31 that have `po_number` present but no billing credit. i'll add repro steps and the simple SQL to locate those: `SELECT s.id, s.po_number FROM sales_memos s LEFT JOIN billing_credits b ON s.id = b.sales_memo_id WHERE s.created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31' AND b.id IS NULL;`

Ryan (Sales): appreciated — i'll coordinate with ops for the backfill and set an internal sales reminder to include `po_number` in the memo field. :+1:

Megan (CS): closing thread — resolved for Orchid Systems. tracked in BILL-7891.
